operator: Téléverbier SA (Verbier, La Tzoumaz, Bruson; co-manages Mont-Fort) with partner lift companies across the 4 Vallées

Official Verbier 4Vallées site: '410 km of slopes', 'Highest point at 3'330 m' (Mont-Fort); factsheet 'Altitude of the resort 1,500 - 3,330 M'. Base 1,350 m remains from the earlier skiresort.info summary.

Official 'About us': 'With 410 km of slopes and 82 lifts, this is the largest ski area entirely in Switzerland'; Verbier sector 106 km and 33 lifts. Lifts by type (sums to 72) are from the earlier skiresort.info search summary; allverbier.ch says 72 lifts.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Ski schools and rental shops operate in Verbier and the other villages; other features not on file

character: Switzerland's largest ski area (412 km on one pass), linking Verbier with Nendaz, Veysonnaz, Thyon, La Tzoumaz and Bruson in Valais. Verbier is known for off-piste and freeride terrain, with Mont Fort (3,330 m) as the high point.
learning: Reference note: each village has ski schools; much of Verbier's own terrain suits intermediate and advanced skiers. Confirm dedicated beginner areas and lesson products.
